With today's new release, users of the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and log workout sets while training. Here are the details.

SmartGym makes it easier to adjust and log workout sets while you train

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has always let users quickly fine-tune details like reps and weight when logging each set.

With today's update, that flexibility has finally arrived on the iPhone app. Users can now freely switch between the existing logging interface and the new "Inline Logging" interface, which lets you adjust values, log sets, and add sets without leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small badge to the bottom-right corner of the reps and weight fields, showing the originally planned value for each set.

After completing a logged set, SmartGym also starts the rest timer right on the same screen, so users can keep training without switching screens.

Here's how SmartGym describes itself:

This is important because SmartGym doesn't just log what you did — it helps you understand what you were supposed to do.

This update also introduces a brand-new keyboard redesigned from the ground up, making the in-workout logging flow smoother. The keyboard includes buttons for quickly incrementing or decrementing values, or switching between normal sets, warm-up sets, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second we give back to you for the thing that matters most — the workout."

Finally, today's update includes a redesigned Smart Action Button that predicts the user's most likely next action, and displays the corresponding action option at the bottom of the interface based on where the user is in their workout.

Options include "Log Set & Rest," "Start Exercise," "First Superset," "Update Set," "Next Exercise," and "End Workout," among others.

SmartGym says they've also improved the smarts behind the Smart Action Button:

The end result is a feature that feels more natural. SmartGym handles the heavy lifting silently in the background, while users simply see exactly what they need, right when they need it.

One last thing: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, letting you manage your workout even faster without touching the app.

SmartGym is available as a free download on the App Store, with various subscription plans offered.
